note: HAND-WRITTEN expectations (not generated by Node) for the D3019 deviation fixtures of spec 7.5. root is relative to this directory; files is the walked file list (sorted); edges are compared as sets. Paths in edges are relative to root. gen/generate.mts checks files against Node's walk and records Node's own output in goldens/graph_deviations_node.json for comparison.

cases.name: alias_baseurl_src
cases.deviation: D3019 alias resolution: baseUrl ./src resolved against the tsconfig directory (Node anchors it at the server's working directory and resolves nothing).

cases.name: alias_extends_baseurl
cases.deviation: D3019 alias resolution through an extends chain: baseUrl ../src declared in config/base.json is resolved against config/, paths are declared in the child tsconfig.json.

cases.name: alias_extends_paths_only
cases.deviation: D3019 alias resolution: paths declared in config/base.json (extends './config/base' without extension) and no baseUrl anywhere, so the base is the directory of the file that declares paths (config/).

cases.name: malformed_tsconfig
cases.deviation: D3019 failure handling: a malformed tsconfig.json only disables alias resolution (Node drops the whole graph). '@/c' must not resolve to src/c.ts.

cases.name: extends_outside_the_clone
cases.deviation: D3019 / AC3050: extends '../outside.json' points outside the clone, so it is not followed and no alias is active. '@o/thing' must not resolve to o/thing.ts.

cases.name: extends_missing_file
cases.deviation: D3019 / AC3050: extends './missing.json' does not exist: alias resolution is disabled, relative imports still produce edges.

cases.name: symlinks_not_followed
cases.deviation: D3019 symbolic links: link.ts and linkdir are symbolic links (not walked, never followed); Node resolves them to their real paths and adds edges importer -> target_a.ts and importer -> libdir/x.ts. The fixture holds real symbolic links.

cases.name: vanished_file
cases.deviation: D3019 failure handling: gone.ts is in the walked file list but does not exist when read; it contributes no specifier and the rest of the graph survives (Node drops the whole graph). The test must pass this explicit list instead of walking.

cases.name: syntax_error_imports
cases.deviation: D3019 broken files: specifiers found in the error-recovered tree (a side-effect import before the error). Depends on tree-sitter error recovery (Go binding 0.25 vs ast-grep 0.26, planner P3): hand-written, check against the Go parser.
